'''Cova''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During a mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arda II]], Cova was attacked and wounded by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-aligned businessman [[Mag Doum]] in a [[Diodem testing plant]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tun Wala]]. As [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was [[Attack on Arda II|attacking]] the planet, local pilot [[Zon Zorad]] flew Cova's [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] due to Cova's injuries.<ref name="live" />
